name: yamlet-pi-source
description: Root manifest so `pi install git:github.com/RicardoMonteiroSimoes/Yamlet` resolves the pi port in pi/. The publishable package is pi/package.json; this file only points pi at it and is deliberately private so it is never published. It declares no dependencies and no scripts, and the Deno CLI in tooling/ imports nothing bare, so it does not participate in that build.
